properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Default cipher of the SDK is AES-256-CBC (CipherInfo() no-arg sets CBC/Size256/PKCS5). CBC is unauthenticated — malleable unless a separate MAC is applied, which this SDK never does. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: bcprov 1.78.1 supplies the RSA implementation the SDK's RSA-2018 DID key support runs on. In this codebase RSA is a verification/signature key type — no RSA encryption path exists (no Cipher.getInstance("RSA...") anywhere).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Deprecated PRF choice for the wallet-password key derivation (docs/api/CRYPTO_SDK-SERVER_API.md §1.1.7). Same call chain is inventoried as the PBKDF2 object ALG-4de3b020 — kept as a separate entry so the weak-PRF signal stays visible.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: bcprov is the provider named in every JCA call here ("BC"); ECDSA is exercised live in EccSignatureProvider.generateSignatureFromHashedData (Signature.getInstance("NoneWithECDSA","BC"), line 55) and via the SHA256withECDSA selector (line 136).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Documented purpose (docs/api/CRYPTO_SDK-SERVER_API.md §1.1.7): derive an AES key from a wallet password. Iteration count and key size are caller-supplied with no enforced minimum in the SDK; PRF is HMAC-SHA1 (ALG-ba399e5b). Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 128-bit variant offered for DID envelope encryption; below CNSA 2.0's AES-256 requirement, 64-bit quantum margin under Grover. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: AES is exercised live through AesEngine (Cipher.getInstance("AES/<mode>/<padding>")) in CBC and selectable ECB modes at 128/256-bit key sizes.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Records that the post-quantum option exists in the shipped dependency — the upgrade path for this SDK's RSA/ECDSA signatures is already on the classpath, unused.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: DID protocol nonce merging (challenge/response binding). DigestUtils.getDigest (lines 34-44) also exposes SHA-384/SHA-512 through CryptoConstant.HASH_ALG_* indirection — SHA-2 is the SDK's only hash family. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Records that the post-quantum KEM is already in the shipped dependency — the direct upgrade path for the SDK's ECDH key agreement, currently unused.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Strongest symmetric variant the SDK offers and its default; Grover leaves a 128-bit margin. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The SDK's randomness source: platform SHA1PRNG (SHA-1-based deterministic DRBG seeded from OS entropy) produces 16-byte nonces and 32-byte salts for DID challenge/response and PBKDF2. Adequate today; a SHA-256-based DRBG is the modern replacement. Not Shor-relevant, no CWE-338 (it is a real CSPRNG, not java.util.Random).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The SDK's sole crypto provider: registered globally at CryptoUtils.java:62 (Security.addProvider(new BouncyCastleProvider())) and named ("BC") in every Signature/KeyFactory/Cipher call. Version 1.78.1 already ships experimental ML-KEM and ML-DSA — the post-quantum upgrade path is present in the dependency; observable here and changeable by version bump.
